paper.summary: Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. paper.summary: Agent evolution follows a simple loop: a proposer writes candidate artifacts (prompts, skills, memories) and selection accepts those that score higher. paper.summary: Games are a rich testbed for visual agents, demanding perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control.
